Deine Aufgaben:

  • Recruiting mit Ownership

    • In Deiner Rolle verantwortest Du End-to-End-Recruiting-Prozesse für unsere Tochtergesellschaften innerhalb der Arsipa Gruppe.

    • Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf Recruiting-Prozessen im Bereich Arbeitsmedizin, Betriebsmedizin und angrenzenden operativen Rollen.

    • Gemeinsam mit Hiring Managern klärst Du Anforderungen, definierst Suchstrategien und sorgst für klare, strukturierte Auswahlprozesse.

    • Strukturierte Interviews, professionelle Einschätzungen und eine wertschätzende Candidate Experience gehören für Dich selbstverständlich dazu.

    • Auch bei mehreren parallelen Vakanzen behältst Du den Überblick - mit Struktur, Priorisierung und einer gesunden Portion Pragmatismus.

  • Active Sourcing & Talent Attraction

    • Passende Talente identifizierst Du über relevante Kanäle und sprichst sie zielgruppengerecht an.

    • Für anspruchsvolle und volumenstarke Rollen entwickelst Du kreative Sourcing-Strategien.

    • Talent Pools baust Du nachhaltig auf und pflegst langfristige Beziehungen zu spannenden Kandidat:innen.

    • Eigene Ideen für eine sichtbarere, nahbarere und überzeugendere Arbeitgebermarke im Recruiting sind ausdrücklich willkommen.

    • Unser Ziel: Kandidat:innen sollen nicht nur wissen, was Arsipa macht — sondern auch verstehen, warum es spannend ist, Teil unserer Reise zu werden.

  • Beratung, Steuerung & Weiterentwicklung

    • Als Sparringspartner/in berätst Du Hiring Manager, Geschäftsführungen und interne Stakeholder rund um Recruiting, Marktansprache und Auswahlentscheidungen.

    • Externe Recruiting-Partner steuerst Du bei Bedarf souverän und stellst sicher, dass Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Kommunikation stimmen.

    • Recruiting-Kennzahlen analysierst Du regelmäßig und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungen für Prozesse, Kanäle und Suchstrategien ab.

    • An der Weiterentwicklung von Recruiting-Prozessen, Interviewstandards, Reporting, Candidate Experience und Employer Branding wirkst Du aktiv mit.

    • In Teamprojekten bringst Du Dich ein und hilfst uns, Recruiting innerhalb einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe skalierbar, professionell und trotzdem menschlich zu gestalten.


Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

  • Das bringst Du mit:

    • Fundierte Erfahrung im End-to-End-Recruiting, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Volumenrecruiting oder GTM Rollen.

    • Starke Expertise im Active Sourcing und in der zielgruppengerechten Direktansprache. Der Umgang mit ATS, modernen Recruiting-Tools, KI-Anwendungen und guten Prompts ist Dir vertraut.

    • Sehr gute Beratungskompetenz im Umgang mit Hiring Managern, Geschäftsführungen und internen Stakeholdern. Dabei arbeitest Du strukturiert, eigenständig und verbindlich.

    • Ein gutes Gespür für Menschen, Kommunikation und unterschiedliche Zielgruppen. Du hast Freude daran, operative Recruiting-Prozesse zu übernehmen und gleichzeitig Prozesse, Standards und Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch; Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

  • Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

    • Erfahrung im Recruiting für GTM-Rollen, Arbeitsmedizin, Betriebsmedizin, Health & Safety, Healthcare oder vergleichbare Fachbereiche.

    • Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer Recruiting-Strukturen in einer wachsenden Organisation.

    • Agenturerfahrung oder Erfahrung in einem sehr dynamischen Recruiting-Umfeld.

    • Kenntnisse im Employer Branding, Recruiting-Marketing oder in der Entwicklung von zielgruppenspezifischen Kampagnen.

    • Affinität zu KPIs, Reporting und datengetriebenem Recruiting.

    • Verständnis für Multi-Entity-, Buy-and-Build- oder stark wachsende Unternehmensstrukturen.

Unsere Benefits:

  • 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei sowie ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag.

  • Full Remote in Deutschland oder hybrides Arbeiten am Standort Berlin.

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung von Prozessen und Strukturen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe - unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus.

  • Offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur, begleitet von regelmäßigen Stand-Ups, sowie monatlichen All-Hands Meetings mit dem gesamten Team, für transparente Kommunikation und zum Feiern der gemeinsamen Erfolge.

  • Gemeinsame Events zur Stärkung des Teamgeistes sowie zur Förderung der positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre.

title: Product Engineer — Working Student
description:
Working Student - Product Engineer

Over 4 million merchants use our card readers to process payments in 34 countries. As we build a world where every business can thrive, we continually expand our range of products and services. We are a truly global fintech company, with 3,000+ people from 93 nationalities spread across 22 offices on four continents.

As the People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience. As our Product Engineer - Working Student, your first mission will be to help us rethink Feedback and Team Reviews: learn how the process works today, find the friction and turn promising ideas into product experiences that colleagues can test.

The work starts frontend-first: build realistic prototypes in React, Next.js or similar and explore a simpler product layer over Workday, our system of record. If a direction proves valuable, you may help grow it into a standalone internal app - from interface and APIs to data models, authentication and integrations - alongside People Tech and engineering partners.

This is a real product challenge, not a side quest: you will learn across discovery, UX, frontend, testing and product decisions, supported by mentorship and code review. You will collaborate with Product Owners, process owners, people tech and workday specialists, sumuppers, managers, people partners, people analytics and senior stakeholders, with potential exposure to backend development, integrations and production delivery. If your favourite way to answer "what if?" is to build it, you will fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Find the right problem: Speak with process owners, employees and managers to understand Feedback and Team Reviews, identify friction and decide what is worth solving first.
  • Shape a focused product slice: Turn requirements, questions and constraints into clear user journeys and an MVP that can teach us something useful.
  • Prototype and iterate quickly: Build realistic frontend experiences in React, Next.js or similar; compare directions, test assumptions and adjust when the evidence points somewhere better.
  • Design for different kinds of work:  Create accessible, intuitive flows for office-based teams, metrics-driven Field Sales colleagues and on-site teams without building three separate products.
  • Think end to end:  If the concept is validated, help evolve it towards a standalone app while considering APIs, data, authentication, privacy, deployment, integrations and what should remain in Workday.
  • Use AI as a co-pilot, not an alibi:  Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Lovable or similar to accelerate development while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Make the learning visible: Demo your work, explain decisions and trade-offs, respond to feedback and document the findings and technical choices that should shape the next version.

You'll be great for this role if

  • Student status. You are currently enrolled at a university and available for a part-time role based in Berlin.
  • Modern web development skills. You have built web applications with React, Next.js or a similar frontend framework. Coursework, internships, hackathons, personal projects and portfolio work all count.
  • Product-minded builder. You care about the user's goal and accessibility, and can turn an ambiguous problem into the simplest useful solution, test it and iterate.
  • Full-stack and AI curiosity. You want to learn how APIs, data and services turn an interface into a reliable product, and can use AI-assisted tools while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Clear, team-first communication. You can explain what you built end to end, make technical choices understandable, ask for input and respond well to feedback.

Nice to have

  • Backend and integration foundations. Some experience with Node.js, TypeScript, Python, databases, APIs, serverless functions, Supabase, Firebase, AWS or comparable technologies.
  • Identity and data concepts. A basic understanding of OAuth, SSO, permissions or responsible data handling.
  • What we don't expect: years of professional experience, previous Workday knowledge or a perfect first attempt. If you do not tick every box, please apply anyway and show us what you can build, how you think and how you learn.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

description:

  • Build out observability so you spot problems before users notice them: metrics, dashboards, alerting

You'll thrive here if:

  • You've operated Kubernetes in production for years. Upgrades, capacity planning, debugging the cluster itself, not just the workloads running on it

  • Observability, GitOps and deployment automation are how you work by default, not extras you bolt on later

Bonus points for:

  • Deep networking knowledge (TLS, TCP/UDP internals)

OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we currently run in production:

  • Infrastructure & platform: Kubernetes (Amazon EKS and on-prem via Rancher), Docker, Linux-based systems, AWS

  • CI/CD & automation: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Ansible, GitOps workflows

  • Databases: MariaDB and PostgreSQL

  • Programming: Go, Python, Bash

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being—supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

 

READY TO JOIN US?

Your Profile

description:
Are you ready to be a technology leader in the SaaS space? Join epilot!

epilot entwickelt ein SaaS-Produkt für den Online-Vertrieb komplexer Produkte – mit dem Ziel, E-Commerce im sich rasant wandelnden Energiemarkt neu zu gestalten. Unsere Mission: Den Verkauf komplexer Energieprodukte so einfach machen wie den Kauf eines Paares Schuhe im Internet.

Über die Stelle

Wir suchen eine:n Integration Solutions Engineer die:der bei epilot die technische Brücke zwischen unserer Plattform und den Systemlandschaften unserer Kunden baut – ERP-Systeme, Drittanbieter-APIs, Cloud-Dienste und externe Partner.

Dies ist mehr als eine klassische Engineering-Rolle: Du arbeitest in Integrationsprojekten direkt mit unseren Kunden zusammen – von der ersten Anforderungsaufnahme über die technische Konzeption bis zum Go-Live. Du verstehst die Prozesse und Systemlandschaften auf Kundenseite, übersetzt Geschäftsanforderungen in robuste technische Lösungen und begleitest die Umsetzung als technische:r Ansprechpartner:in end-to-end. Du schreibst produktionsreifen Code, entwirfst zuverlässige Datenflüsse und verantwortest deine Projekte von Anfang bis Ende selbst – ohne zwischengeschaltete Projektmanager.

Wenn du es liebst, technische Lösungen gemeinsam mit Kunden zu entwickeln, die Komplexität realer Systemlandschaften zu durchdringen und Integrationsprojekte eigenverantwortlich zum Erfolg zu führen, dann ist diese Stelle genau das Richtige für dich.

Schau dir unser Versprechen an dich an: promise.epilot.cloud


Das erwartet dich

  • Eigenverantwortliche Leitung von Integrationsprojekten – von der Anforderungsanalyse beim Kunden über die Architektur bis zur produktiven Inbetriebnahme.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und deren IT-Teams: Du bist die technische Ansprechperson, führst Workshops durch, stimmst Schnittstellen ab und begleitest den gesamten Integrationsprozess.

  • Aufbau und Pflege von Integrationen zwischen der epilot-Plattform und externen Systemen (ERPs, Drittanbieter-APIs, Partnerdienste)

  • Design und Implementierung von event-driven, asynchronen Datenpipelines

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Integrationspartnern und ERP-Anbietern – von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Fehlerbehebung bis hin zur kontinuierlichen Abstimmung

  • Definition und Verwaltung der Cloud-Infrastruktur mittels Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

  • Sicherstellung zuverlässiger, nachvollziehbarer und widerstandsfähiger Integrationen – mit sauberem Fehlerhandling, nicht nur für den Idealfall

Mehr über unsere Architektur und unseren Tech-Stack erfährst du hier: Introduction to epilot | epilot dev center

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in der technischen Projektarbeit mit Kunden – du kannst Anforderungen aufnehmen, technische Konzepte verständlich vermitteln und Integrationsprojekte eigenständig steuern

  • Kommunikationsstärke im Partnerumfeld – du managst externe Beziehungen selbstständig, hakst nach, setzt dich durch, wenn nötig und hältst Integrationen auf Kurs – ohne dass ein PM das für dich übernehmen muss

  • Produktionsreife Programmierkenntnisse – du schreibst Backend-Code, der zuverlässig im Produktivbetrieb läuft, nicht nur Prototypen

  • Cloud-Erfahrung (AWS bevorzugt) – du hast bereits Deployments in der Cloud durchgeführt und Infrastruktur mit IaC-Tools wie Terraform oder CloudFormation verwaltet

  • Event-driven Architektur & asynchrones Messaging – du verstehst Message Queues, Pub/Sub-Muster und weißt, warum sie für Integrationsarbeit entscheidend sind

  • REST-API-Design und -Nutzung – du entwickelst und konsumierst APIs als zentralen Bestandteil deiner Arbeit

  • Authentifizierungsmechanismen – du kennst OAuth2 und API-Key-Authentifizierung und weißt, wann du welche einsetzt

  • Reliability patterns – Retries, idempotency, Dead-Letter-Queues und Circuit Breaker sind für dich selbstverständliche Praxis, keine nachträglichen Gedanken

  • Serverless-Grundlagen – du verstehst das Paradigma und kannst einschätzen, wann es sinnvoll ist (praktische Erfahrung ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung)

  • Deutschkenntnisse – Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – im direkten Austausch mit deutschsprachigen Partnern und Anbietern genauso wie im internationalen Teamkontext.

Dein Mindset

  • Ownership: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das, was in Production läuft.

  • Produktdenken statt Ticketdenken.

  • Pragmatischer Problemlöser.

  • Du kommst auch mit Unklarheiten gut zurecht.

Was wir dir bieten
Bei epilot glauben wir daran, Leistung zu belohnen, Wachstum zu fördern und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem du aufblühst:

  • Ein zu 100 % serverless AWS-Produkt im produktiven Einsatz.

  • Wirkungsvolle Arbeit: Gestalte das Integrations-Rückgrat eines Produkts mit, das den Energiesektor neu definiert.

  • Startup-Mentalität: Dynamisches Umfeld, flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation.

  • Flexibilität: Arbeite remote oder aus unserem zentral gelegenen Büro in Köln – mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

  • Wachstumsmöglichkeiten: Deine Karriere kann so schnell wachsen wie wir. Lerne, experimentiere und lebe die „Fail Fast and Often"-Mentalität.

The opportunity

LLMs are changing analytical work. Capabilities that once required large teams of highly paid data engineers are becoming accessible to smaller companies for the first time. At Palantir, we delivered real data and BI value, but deployments never scaled without expensive, hands-on engineers. We believe LLMs change that, and we have the customers and revenue to prove the model works.

Now we scale and one key lever is the platform. Every new customer brings new data sources, more rows to sync, and more queries to serve. Your job is to make sure ZeitMind, our agent platform, can handle onboarding 10 new enterprise customers per week and the hard part isn't the compute. It's capturing each business's context fast enough: connecting messy data systems, making sure the agent's answers are correct, that visualisations hold up, and that the customer is able to get value out of the product quickly. This is as much a product and correctness problem as an infrastructure one, and it hasn't been solved before. Onboarding a customer should be boring. This is the role that lets everything else scale.

What you will do

  • Build the sync layer: millions of rows from ERP, CRM, and homegrown systems, ingested incrementally and reliably, without an engineer babysitting the pipeline

  • Cut onboarding time: connecting a new customer's data sources should take hours, not weeks. You abstract sources so our agents work with any of them the same way

  • Make the agent fast where it counts: speed comes from tool design that parallelizes, sub-agents, and branching, not tokens per second. You design tools so work can run concurrently and safely

  • Route data safely between customer networks and ours: security and reliability are features our customers pay for

  • Build the guardrails for correctness: automatic checks and integrated validation tooling so the agent's output can be trusted, and so it flags what a human should verify

  • Keep the platform simple: choose boring technology where boring wins, and be able to say why every system we run earns its place

  • have built or scaled data platforms before and think clearly about data processing architectures

  • take full ownership from idea to production to impact, and are comfortable working without predefined specs

  • want to build foundations early rather than optimize mature systems

  • are genuinely interested in the data and agentic space and how LLMs enable new workflows for non-technical users

  • You've been a lead architect or equivalent: built many systems yourself, and seen how large systems fail and evolve. You're here to learn from customers and take bets on a product that doesn't exist yet, not to learn how to write software.

title: ML Engineer — AI & Operations Research (all genders)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Group and MICE business is one of the last scientifically underserved problems in revenue management. Transient pricing has decades of literature and tooling; group pricing — with its displacement effects, function-space coupling, multi-resource capacity constraints, and negotiation dynamics — remains largely heuristic across the industry. We are building the system that changes that, and this role owns its mathematical core.

You will formulate and solve the optimization problems behind Rocket’s intelligence layer: given a group request, current bookings, forecasted transient demand, and function-space availability — what decision maximizes the hotel’s GOP? That single objective — measurable gross operating profit uplift for our customers — is the north star of everything you build. These are genuine OR problems: mixed-integer programs, stochastic demand models, displacement cost estimation — and your formulations run in production, pricing real group business for enterprise hotel chains.


  • Optimization models for group pricing and capacity allocation. Formulate the core decision problems as mathematical programs: MILP formulations for room-block and function-space allocation, displacement-cost models quantifying what a group booking crowds out, and price-recommendation logic with business guardrails as explicit constraints. Own solver strategy (Gurobi / CPLEX / OR-Tools), formulation efficiency, and solution-time guarantees suitable for interactive use.
  • Demand forecasting and stochastic modeling. Build the forecasting layer the optimizer consumes: transient demand forecasts by segment and stay date, group conversion probability models, cancellation and materialization estimates — with rigorous backtesting on our Databricks data platform.
  • Insight generation. Build the analytical layer that tells a hotel why — counterfactual analysis (“what would GOP have been under a different pricing policy?”), what-if simulation for revenue managers, and structured recommendations derived from historical RFP and booking data. The output is not a dashboard; it is a defensible, quantified action a revenue director can take.
  • Scientific rigor in production. Establish the methodological standard: reproducible experiments, benchmark instances, ablations against heuristic baselines, and honest measurement of realized revenue impact at customers. What ships must be defensible — to a hotel’s revenue director and to a referee.

What success looks like:

  • 3 months: A first optimization model (e.g., displacement-based price floors) validated against historical booking data and benchmarked against current heuristic practice.
  • 12 months: The optimization core prices group business in production at multiple customers with measured GOP uplift, the insight layer is a selling point in our enterprise deals — and you are positioned to take ownership of the AI team. A body of results strong enough for an OR or revenue-management venue (e.g., INFORMS) is a welcome side effect.

Project Background:

Margins 2 Markets (M2M) is building key components of an effective waste management system in three ecologically valuable coastal regions: Raja Ampat/Sorong (Indonesia), Tamil Nadu (India), and Zanzibar (Tanzania). description:

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About the role

We're looking for a motivated Working Student (Werkstudent) to join our IT team and gain hands-on experience supporting a fast-paced, AI-driven technology company.

This is an excellent opportunity for a university student who wants to develop practical IT skills while continuing their studies. You'll work alongside experienced IT professionals, learning how technology operations support a growing global business.

Based in our office, you'll gain exposure to modern workplace technologies, IT service management, hardware operations, and AI-powered tools that are used every day across DeepL.

What you'll do

As part of the IT team, you'll support a variety of day-to-day operational activities, including:

  • Prepare, configure, cleanse, and manage IT hardware for employees.

  • Maintain accurate IT asset records and update internal systems to reflect hardware changes.

  • Learn and follow IT operational processes in a live production environment.

  • Support employees by assisting with IT requests and incidents through Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite.

  • Gain hands-on experience with corporate technologies including Google Workspace, Zoom, and Claude AI.

  • Assist with onboarding and offboarding activities, ensuring equipment is prepared and tracked correctly.

  • Provide general administrative and ad hoc support to the IT team as required.

  • Continuously develop your technical knowledge while contributing to the smooth running of our internal IT operations.

    We're looking for someone who is curious, organised, and excited to learn.

You'll ideally have:

  • Current enrolment in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

  • A genuine interest in IT support, workplace technology, or IT operations.

  • Learn from experienced IT professionals through day-to-day mentorship.

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities.   • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: Growth Intern - Automation & AI
description:
Über uns

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

  • Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,

  • ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und

  • digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

  • Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase

  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend

Deine Aufgaben

Mission der Rolle

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Growth Konrad und unserem CEO Julius zusammen und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unseres AI-enabled Growth Set-ups.

Dein Ziel: Unsere Projektleiter:innen bei der Umsetzung unterstützen, interne Prozesse weiterentwickeln und datenbasierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen. Dabei wirst du ein tiefes Verständnis für Energieprojekte, Operations und Business-Aufbau entwickeln.

1. Prozessanalyse & Priorisierung

  • Du screenst gemeinsam mit den Teams (u. a. Sales, Partnerships, CEO Office) bestehende Abläufe und identifizierst, wo manuelle Arbeit am meisten Zeit kostet

  • Du bewertest Automatisierungspotenzial nach Aufwand vs. Impact und leitest daraus eine klare Priorisierung ab

  • Du hältst Anforderungen und Prozesslogik so fest, dass daraus direkt eine Lösung gebaut werden kann

2. Technische Umsetzung

  • Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Komplexität sowie Optimierungspotenziale

  • Du hilfst dabei, Entscheidungsprozesse zu strukturieren und Automatisierungen operativ sauber aufzusetzen

  • Du unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer technologischer Strukturen, Standards und Templates für operative Projekte

3. Prozessoptimierung & interne Strukturen

  • Du entwickelst interne Prozesse und Tools (z. B. in Airtable) weiter, um operative Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit zu erhöhen

  • Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in bestehenden Abläufen und setzt konkrete Optimierungen, z.B. mittels Automatisierungen (Claude), um

  • Du übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Special Projects in den Bereichen Organisation, Tooling und interne Strukturen

Benefits

Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Ruby on Rails (m/f/d) at Solar Startup
description:
About Us

At VREY, we're building the EnergyOS for multi-family buildings.

Germany has over 3.3 million apartment buildings — and they are the blind spot of the energy transition. <1% solar penetration. <2% smart metering. Almost no flexibility or intelligent energy management.

At the same time, regulation is forcing property owners into major investment: solar is becoming mandatory, smart meters must be rolled out nationwide within five years, heating and mobility are electrifying. The apartment building is transforming from passive real estate into an active part of the decentralised energy infrastructure.

What's missing is an integrated system that makes this transition economically viable and operationally manageable.

VREY combines certified meter operation with proprietary software, enabling property owners to sell self-generated solar power directly to their tenants — simply, and without having to become an energy supplier themselves (§42b EnWG). Regulatory obligation becomes a profitable, predictable opportunity:

  • Double-digit returns and asset appreciation for owners,

  • ~20% electricity cost savings for tenants, and

  • digital infrastructure for storage, heat pumps, and flexibility.

We already manage a three-digit number of projects — including some of Germany's largest property holders and housing cooperatives — in all 16 federal states. In the course of our seed financing, we raised €3.3M from leading impact and energy VCs (including Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, and Kopa Ventures). We're now entering the next growth phase and expanding our team.

We're at the beginning of a structural market shift. Join us and help build the leading EnergyOS.

Your Profile

  • You have 2+ years of professional experience building and running full-stack web applications, ideally with Ruby on Rails. Experience in comparable frameworks (Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, NextJS) will also be considered, if you are truly motivated to learn and work with Rails.

  • You have a strong understanding and hands-on experience designing and optimizing relational database schemas (we use PostgreSQL).

  • You are used to working with APIs and integrating with 3rd-party services.

  • You have solid experience setting up and maintaining cloud/server infrastructure. We have a basic Heroku setup and Github CI/CD and need to gradually scale and improve monitoring etc.

  • You have at least basic frontend development skills, ideally with solid fundamentals (HTML, CSS and JavaScript), as well as familiarity with both the Rails way (Hotwire, Turbo and Stimulus) and a framework like React or Vue.

  • You like to take ownership for the features and components you work on and you are proactive in the product development.

  • You are based in Berlin (or willing to relocate). You will enjoy working in our office in Friedrichshain with the team most of the time, with the flexibility of 1-2 remote work days a week.

  • You are willing to learn energy industry terms in English and German and being comfortable with some parts of the company operating mostly in German. (Team language is English.)

You will be an early member of our growing product development team, working across the entire stack.

The core functionality of the VREY platform is processing smart meter measurement data for analyzing and billing solar power usage. For this purpose, we provide landlords and tenants with a portal and automate contract management, invoicing and payment flows. An admin interface and integration with internal tools enable the creation and management of projects by our operations team.

While working on features and integrations, you also help us improve our infrastructure and backend processes, enabling our platform to scale.

  • You co-design and build features across the full stack, from database to UI.

  • You work directly with product management, design and internal users to get the details right.

  • You ensure that our features perform well for a growing number of users.

  • You co-own the development of our crucial backend processes: importing and processing of smart meter measurement data and automated billing.

  • You help designing and maintaining the underlying server infrastructure.

  • You instrument, optimize and monitor critical processes so they remain fast, reliable and dependable as we scale.

3. Technical design, architecture and engineering excellence

  • You research, evaluate and design technical solutions to new problems together with the team.

  • You contribute to our aspiration to get better and more efficient as engineers and as a team every day.

  • You continuously improve our development environment and engineering processes, including adopting the right tools, workflows and AI-powered development practices.

  • Great workplace: Office in a cool co-working space in Berlin-Friedrichshain, with free drinks, cerials, fruits, and plenty of lunch options nearby.

When it comes to text and images, giants like OpenAI and Google have already cracked the code. With video, Veo3, Sora and others are closing the gap rapidly. But with its endless languages, dialects, accents, subtle intonations, and speech melodies voice remains a highly complex unsolved frontier.

That is exactly why we started Deepslate. Backed by top-tier investors from the Tech and AI sectors, as well as major German VC funds, we are incredibly well-funded and moving fast.

We are building the future of communication.

We aren't trying to build another standalone platform; instead, we are the intelligence engine powering countless other applications. Whether it's integrated as a module by a CRM provider, plugged into another Voice AI platform, or directly embedded into an enterprise system by our integration partners - our model is everywhere.

Your Role

Our model speaks for itself in every demo. But the people who should hear about it (enterprise decision-makers, platform builders, investors) don't spend their days in demos. They spend them on LinkedIn. Your mission is to build Deepslate's social media presence from the ground up and completely own it: the personal profiles of our two founders Paskal & Jan (CEO & CTO), built from zero, and our company page alongside them.

You won't start from zero on knowledge: We already have seven-figure impressions through personal profiles, and the learnings are documented. Product context, target audience, and content pillars are defined, and especially in the beginning you'll get intensive support from our growth team.

This is not an execution role with a finished playbook; it's a builder role with a strong foundation. The role is designed for part-time or working student capacity: We believe 15 to 20 focused hours with real ownership beat a full-time checklist. We'll define the exact scope and priorities together based on your availability.

Give Deepslate a Voice on LinkedIn

You'll turn our founders' knowledge and our customers' real stories into content that keeps enterprises and investors warm over months, and make a complex technology feel tangible, credible, and worth following.

  • Build & Own: Take complete ownership of our LinkedIn presence: positioning, content strategy, editorial planning, every single post, the approval workflow, and reporting. From zero to a channel that matters.

  • Founder Ghostwriting: Turn short conversations and voice memos into posts that sound like our founders, not like marketing. Founder content runs primarily in English.

  • Short-Form Video: Produce clips and story formats from real customer projects, founder insights, and product moments. We shoot together in Berlin.

  • Community: Comments, DMs, and genuine exchange with our B2B audience: contact centers, Voice AI platforms, and enterprise decision-makers.

Take Our Content Game to the Next Level:

  • Data-Driven Growth: Track reach, engagement, and inbound requests. Test hooks and formats systematically, build your own reporting, and let the numbers decide what gets scaled.

  • AI as Leverage: We're an AI company, internally too. Build an AI-assisted content workflow with us, from research to drafts to design, and keep pushing it further. Our goal is real leverage: more output, higher quality, faster learning loops.

  • Employee Advocacy: Help design the incentive program that gets our whole team posting on LinkedIn: templates, coaching, and a mechanism that turns the team into a reach multiplier.

What We're Looking For: Must-Haves:

  • Experience in social media management with a B2B / LinkedIn focus, ideally with examples or profiles we can look at (including your own).

  • Excellent writing in English and German: founder content is primarily in English, our audience is European.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • A confident hand with short-form video editing (CapCut, Premiere & co.), or the drive to learn it fast.

  • Previous experience in a fast-paced Startup or DeepTech environment.

title: Working Student, IT (Werkstudent)
description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About the role

We're looking for a motivated Working Student (Werkstudent) to join our IT team and gain hands-on experience supporting a fast-paced, AI-driven technology company.

This is an excellent opportunity for a university student who wants to develop practical IT skills while continuing their studies. You'll work alongside experienced IT professionals, learning how technology operations support a growing global business.

Based in our office, you'll gain exposure to modern workplace technologies, IT service management, hardware operations, and AI-powered tools that are used every day across DeepL.

What you'll do

As part of the IT team, you'll support a variety of day-to-day operational activities, including:

  • Prepare, configure, cleanse, and manage IT hardware for employees.

  • Maintain accurate IT asset records and update internal systems to reflect hardware changes.

  • Learn and follow IT operational processes in a live production environment.

  • Support employees by assisting with IT requests and incidents through Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite.

  • Gain hands-on experience with corporate technologies including Google Workspace, Zoom, and Claude AI.

  • Assist with onboarding and offboarding activities, ensuring equipment is prepared and tracked correctly.

  • Provide general administrative and ad hoc support to the IT team as required.

  • Continuously develop your technical knowledge while contributing to the smooth running of our internal IT operations.

    What we're looking for

    We're looking for someone who is curious, organised, and excited to learn.

You'll ideally have:

  • Current enrolment in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

  • A genuine interest in IT support, workplace technology, or IT operations.

  • Basic technical knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, or troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, or similar productivity platforms is beneficial.

  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to work with colleagues across the business.

  • A proactive mindset, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks.

  • Enthusiasm for learning new technologies and working in an AI-first environment.

  • Good level of English written and verbal

What you'll gain

This role is designed to help you build practical experience while studying. You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Learn from experienced IT professionals through day-to-day mentorship.

  • Gain real-world experience supporting technology in a global SaaS business.

  • Develop skills with enterprise tools including Google Workspace, Zoom, Jira, Atlassian, and AI-powered technologies such as Claude.

  • Build an understanding of IT service management and corporate technology operations.

  • Work in a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team environment.

Working pattern

  • Working Student (Werkstudent)

  • Up to 20 hours per week during term time (in line with local regulations)

  • Onsite at our office

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

About the Role

We're building WunderGraph Cosmo, the open-source GraphQL Federation solution. Probably the most important component of Cosmo is the Cosmo Router, which - simply put - connects all API endpoints and handles the GraphQL requests and responses whilst applying the Federation protocol (among other magical things, like normalization, execution planning etc.). Fully written in Go, it's the fastest GraphQL Router available and a quite potent (and complex) piece of cutting-edge open-source software. How about joining our team to make it even better and strap the rocket boosters onto GraphQL Federation?

 

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • You align with the Product team and Customer Success teams for product feedback

  • You support and consult with the engineering team.

     

You will be in charge of

  • Develop, refactor and maintain GraphQL Go Tools' (Router) open-source code base in Golang (low GC code)

  • Work closely with your engineering team mates on new Router capabilities (e.g. Open Federation, new data sources)

  • Focus on performance, security and stability of the Router

  • Review Router telemetry to identify areas of improvement

  • Run internal penetration tests of the Router

  • Troubleshoot Router issues, potentially together with our customers' engineers

  • Analyze and accept up open-source contributions on Github

     

The "Engine" is essentially a Golang application which translates GraphQL requests into any other protocol, like OpenAPI, SOAP, gRPC, GraphQL, Apollo Federation, etc. You could consider the Engine as a "GraphQL Compiler" or Transpiler. The Engine is responsible for parsing, normalization, execution planning, execution runtime, etc... If you are interested in working with ASTs, AST transformations, etc... you will love this kind of work. We have performance requirements, so you should be proficient in writing performant and low GC code in Golang.

Some of your tasks will take more than a few weeks to complete, Ideally, you're someone who likes to go deep on one topic instead of going wide and shallow on many different topics.

 

Here's a list of things you might be working on:

  • Extend the Compiler "backend" to support Apollo Federation v2

  • Extend the Compiler "backend" to support gRPC

  • Implement a native Go-based data source for SOAP and OpenAPI, currently we're using a Node.js based solution with a bridge

  • Improve the batching-implementation of the Engine

  • Improve the performance of the Engine in general, driven by feedback from our customers

  • Senior/Staff level of proven Golang development experience in a leading / ownership role (must have)

  • Self-starter with a clear sense of priorities - no hand-holding needed

  • You must be willing and able to work out solutions on your own. This requires you to dig into hard problems and stay on target until you have solved an issue in a robust way.

  • Experience in working with ASTs, AST transformations etc.

  • Experience in writing performant and low GC code in Golang, and knowledge of how to benchmark Go code

  • You are able to work and thrive in a fully remote environment

  • Excellent communicator (important for a remote team) in English

  • You are willing and able to travel occasionally to meet the team in person (at least twice a year) or join working meetings.

  • You are able to work within the CET time zone.

Bonus points:

  • Experience with GraphQL, API Gateways, Proxies, and Networking in general is a plus

  • Experience with OpenAPI, SOAP, gRPC, GraphQL, Apollo Federation is a plus

  • Existing Open Source Contributions

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers love our product because it works flawlessly, securely and fast - and because it looks darn pretty, too!

  • Developers love our product because of the exceptional DX (as said before, we’re an engineering company, so we care a lot about DX)

  • Your teammates love to work with you because you never let them down, share your knowledge, and ship like crazy as a team

  • Proper tests and clean code that prevent outages and security issues

  • You grow along with us

     

Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

     

THE PROCESS

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 45 min technical background call with one of our engineers. Following this, you will receive a small take home assignment / programming task (max 1 - 2h effort) related to our open source platform. This is your chance to prove your skill!

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

description:
Wer wir sind:
Wir entwickeln die Intelligenz, die es Robotern ermöglicht, die reale Welt wahrzunehmen, zu verstehen und in ihr zu handeln – über das Labor hinaus und hinein in den industriellen Alltag, etwa in Lagerhallen und Fabriken. Wir suchen eine prozessorientierte Person, die im operativen technischen Einkauf, das kaufmännische Fundament unserer innovativen Robotiklösungen bei Sereact stärkt.
Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere internen kaufmännischen Abläufe und bist ein echtes Organisationstalent, das sich gerne mitten ins Geschehen stürzt und dafür sorgt, dass unser Tagesgeschäft im Hintergrund reibungslos läuft.
Die Stelle ist in Stuttgart angesiedelt und eignet sich ideal für jemanden, der gerne strukturierte Prozesse aufbaut, kaufmännische Aufgaben steuert und ein Team unterstützt, das an modernster Technologie arbeitet.


Deine Aufgaben:

  • Projekt- und Auftragsmanagement: Du steuerst unsere Projekte aus kaufmännischer Sicht, von der ersten Bestellung bis zur finalen Lieferung.

  • Einkauf und Materialwirtschaft: Du unterstützt die Beschaffung von Komponenten und pflegst enge Beziehungen zu unseren Lieferanten.

  • Bestandsmanagement: Du behältst unsere Lagerbestände im Blick und stellst sicher, dass alle Komponenten zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind.

  • Allgemeine Administration: Von der vorbereitenden Buchhaltung bis zur Stammdatenpflege sorgst du dafür, dass unser Tagesgeschäft reibungslos läuft.

Qualifikationen:

  • Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Industriekaufmann/zur Industriekauffrau oder ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre.

  • Erfahrung: Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer kaufmännischen oder operativen Rolle.

  • Mindset: Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität. Keine Aufgabe ist dir zu klein oder zu komplex, wenn das Team Unterstützung braucht.

  • Antrieb: Deine Motivation und Lernbereitschaft sind uns wichtiger als tiefgehendes Branchenwissen in der Robotik.

  • Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, idealerweise Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich.

Unser Interviewprozess:

  • Bewerbung

  • Cultural-Fit-Interview (40 Min.): Ein Gespräch darüber, wie du arbeitest, was dich motiviert und wonach du suchst. Es erwarten dich Fragen zu deinem Lebenslauf, deinem „Warum" und Zeit für deine eigenen Fragen.

  • Fachliches Interview (45 Min.): Ein tieferer Einblick in deine Fähigkeiten und deinen Problemlösungsansatz für diese Rolle.

  • Gespräch mit den Gründern: Du triffst einen unserer Gründer, um über die Rolle und deinen Werdegang zu sprechen. Eine gute Gelegenheit, mehr über die Vision von Sereact zu erfahren, Fragen zu stellen und ein klares Gefühl für unsere Unternehmenskultur und Arbeitsumgebung zu bekommen.

Was wir bieten:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice bei Bedarf

  • Ein motiviertes Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur

We believe getting a physical product to market shouldn't mean fighting spreadsheets, PDFs, and supplier emails just to prove it's safe and legal to sell. We work with many of the worlds largest retailers and brands across fashion, furniture, cosmetics, toys, electronics and many other product categories. We’re backed by Y Combinator, and a roster of investors who see what we see: Product compliance is the next major infrastructure category, and we’re leading it.

About the role

We're looking for an entrepreneurial salesperson who wants huge responsibility: Bringing Complir to Germany, closing enterprise deals, and shaping our presence in Europe's biggest market.

Product compliance is not a topic that makes people lean in at dinner parties. But every product you've ever bought, from your kid's toy dinosaur to your electric toothbrush, had to clear a wall of regulation before it reached you. Most companies manage that wall with spreadsheets, inbox archaeology, and one very tired quality manager.

Nowhere is that wall higher than in Germany: the largest consumer market in Europe, home to the manufacturers and brands most exposed to tightening EU regulation, and a market that takes compliance more seriously than anyone. We're fixing this with AI, and we want you to be the person who brings it there.

You'll be Complir's first person on the ground in Germany, focused on enterprise: Manufacturers and brands with 1,000+ active products, complex multi-market exposure, and compliance teams drowning in spreadsheets. You'll build your own pipeline and close your own enterprise deals. That means picking up the phone, working your network, and creating opportunities where none existed, with founders and our GTM team behind every deal.

We're looking for a self-starting enterprise seller with an entrepreneurial streak - several years of enterprise B2B sales experience, ideally with some background selling into or working in legal, compliance, or regulatory functions.

Then comes the second act. As the first customers land, you build the German pod around you: account executives, customer success, eventually a German office with your fingerprints on everything. Germany is the mandate today; Austria and Switzerland follow once Germany works, and the person who built Germany is the natural owner of DACH.

You'll start with 2 weeks at our Copenhagen HQ. This is where you absorb the product, the pitch, and the compliance domain, sitting next to the founders and the GTM team, and where you start building your German pipeline from day one.

From there, you're based in Germany, running your own market. You'll be back in Copenhagen for 2 weeks every quarter, working closely with our Head of France and the rest of the team to compare notes across markets, sharpen the playbook, and bring what's working in each country back to your own.

You will love this job, if you are:

  • An experienced enterprise seller with several years closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B SaaS deals, ideally in the €100k+ ACV range

  • A native-level or full professional German speaker with fluent English. You'll sell in Germany and work internally in English

  • Experienced with (or curious about) selling into compliance, regulatory, quality, or retail.

  • Comfortable being the only Complirian in your market, without being a lone wolf: you'll pull on the founders and product daily
